fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS • Potential for Genotoxicity and Carcinogenicity. ( 5.1 ) • Embryo-Fetal Toxicity: May cause fetal harm. Pregnancy testing is recommended for females of reproductive potential. Advise females of reproductive potential of the potential risk to a fetus and to use effective contraception.…

summary: Official warnings state that Nifurtimox has the potential to cause cancer and gene damage, and it may also harm an unborn baby [4]. Because of this risk of harm to a fetus, pregnancy testing and effective birth control are advised for females who can become pregnant [4]. A small computer model, rather than tests in people, estimated a high score for liver issues and a low score for heart issues [M]. Additionally, a similar drug called Dantrolene carries a boxed warning in the United States for liver harm [3].
